note: vid-capture is bank maintenance, not a per-video pipeline step, so it consumes only the shared foundation + banks fixture tree. There is no upstream stage to freeze. Each case names one capture flow (stage S/M/P/T/F) driven by one seed. Corpus seeds are reused where their persona material is bankable; capture-seeds.json (suite-local) adds raw material for the testimonial, framework, proof, and visual-metaphor flows the video corpus does not cover. The runner writes outputs/case_NN/ as: {entry_type}-{slug}.md for the bank entry (the prefix stands in for banks/{type}-bank/), people-{Full-Name}.md for new stubs or 'already exists' notes, and transcript.md for the capture conversation. eval.py scores the bank files and stubs. transcript.md is never brand- or fabrication-scored because it legitimately echoes the creator, but it IS legitimate source text: a number in an entry must trace to the seed, the persona, or something the creator said in the transcript.
